title: 6-Day Istanbul, Bursa & Princes' Islands Tour
metaTitle: 6 Days in Istanbul, Bursa & Princes’ Islands | Tour Package
metaDescription: Enjoy a 6-day Turkey itinerary featuring Istanbul’s landmarks, Bursa’s mosques, and a relaxing day trip to the Princes’ Islands. Book your journey today!

summary:
The 6-Day Istanbul, Bursa & Princes' Islands Tour uses Istanbul as your base while adding two very different day trips beyond the city center. Explore Istanbul’s Byzantine and Ottoman landmarks and cruise the Bosphorus, then take the ferry to Büyükada for a quieter view of life on the Princes’ Islands. A separate excursion to Bursa introduces the city’s early Ottoman heritage, historic mosques and traditional market areas.
With five nights in the same Istanbul hotel, there is no need to repack between excursions. Your stay includes selected 4-star accommodation with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, airport transfers, the Bosphorus cruise, entrance fees and the scheduled sightseeing in the program.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise & Beylerbeyi Palace
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar and enjoy a scenic cruise along the Bosphorus. Continue across the Bosphorus Bridge to Camlıca Hill for panoramic city views, followed by a visit to the elegant Beylerbeyi Palace. Return to hotel Overnight in Istanbul

itinerary.title: Princes’ Islands Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast, enjoy a ferry ride to the beautiful Princes' Islands. Visit Buyukada, the largest island of the chain, and explore its peaceful streets, elegant historic mansions, and scenic coastline by electric vehicle. Return to Istanbul in the evening. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Bursa
itinerary.text: After breakfast, depart for Bursa. Visit the historic Green Mosque and Green Tomb, followed by the famous Grand Mosque of Bursa. Enjoy a scenic cable car ride on Uludag with panoramic mountain views before returning to Istanbul. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What attractions are included in the 6 Day Istanbul Tour?
faqs.a: The 6 Day Istanbul Tour includes Istanbul's most famous landmarks, such as Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, Basilica Cistern, Grand Bazaar, Spice Bazaar, Beylerbeyi Palace, and a Bosphorus Cruise. The itinerary also features excursions to Bursa and the Princes' Islands, offering a combination of history, culture, nature, and local life. The tour runs for 5 nights and 6 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 6 Day Istanbul Tour cost?
faqs.a: Current prices are shown above and may vary according to travel dates, hotel category, and availability. The package includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees according to the itinerary, selected meals, airport transfers, and transportation for the Bursa and Princes' Islands excursions.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of the Bursa and Princes' Islands tours?
faqs.a: Bursa is known as the first capital of the Ottoman Empire and features attractions such as the Grand Mosque, Green Mosque, Green Tomb, and historic Silk Market. The Princes' Islands offer a peaceful escape from the city with scenic waterfront views, charming streets, historic mansions, and a relaxing island atmosphere.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 5 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, quality, and convenient locations near Istanbul's major attractions. All airport and hotel transfers are included throughout the tour.

faqs.q: Does the 6 Day Istanbul Tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during all scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guide will provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise while ensuring a smooth and enjoyable travel experience.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Istanbul?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors. It combines Istanbul's most iconic monuments with day trips to Bursa and the Princes' Islands, providing a comprehensive introduction to the city's history, culture, and surrounding attractions.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through historic districts, bazaars, museums, palace grounds, and island streets. Most sightseeing involves moderate walking and is suitable for travelers in average health.

faqs.q: What is included in the Bosphorus Cruise?
faqs.a: The Bosphorus Cruise offers breathtaking views of Istanbul's skyline, Ottoman palaces, waterfront mansions, historic fortresses, and the bridges linking Europe and Asia. It is one of the most memorable experiences included in the itinerary.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 6 Day Istanbul Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 6 Day Istanbul Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include additional excursions, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
